title: Saronic media frame
description: A stand-in for any photo or video: a flat muted surface with a faint steel-blue wash from the top that takes its size, aspect ratio and radius from the caller, or crops a real image or video placed in it like object-fit cover.
notes: empty, it is aria-hidden and never draws the subject it replaces
inside a `dark` band it takes the dark muted tone
name: saronic-placeholder

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video to show; it is stretched to cover the frame

props.name: className
props.description: size, aspect ratio, radius and position of the frame
